sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You have reminded us more than once that you held prices steady for us—it sounds like you want that partnership reciprocated, not merely acknowledged. We value that support and want a fair adjustment grounded in verified cost drivers while supporting your cash flow. How could faster payment help us agree a cost-based price adjustment and a transition that works for both of us?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 30%, PPI-C241 24%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C241 +6.2%), your cost increase comes to about +2.0% of the price, not +9.5%. Our should-cost estimate for Volute casing HN 50-200 is EUR 132.64 per 1 (cost:310010). Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 86% of your invoices late, on average 3 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 3 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 127.31 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and should cost data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. 

However, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. While we acknowledge the index data you provided, our operational expenses remain substantial and require a fair adjustment to sustain our foundry's standards. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. We appreciate your commitment to improving payment reliability and your proposal of 14-day payment terms. We are prepared to accept the 14-day payment terms and the later effective date of 1 January 2027, provided we agree on a unit price of €134.50.

Thus, our Angebot stands at a price of €134.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You acknowledge the index evidence while repeatedly stressing the remaining cost pressures—it sounds like sustaining your foundry’s standards is what a fair adjustment must protect. We value our long-standing partnership and want dependable, prompt payment to support an adjustment grounded in verified cost movements, without asking you to open your calculation. How can we reflect the verified decline in electricity producer prices alongside the labour and material increases you highlighted?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -17.1% from 2025-02 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-02, idx:PPI-D351@2026-02). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +2.0%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 128.04 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We respect the confidentiality of your calculation and value the longstanding partnership, including the price stability you supported in the past. How can we use payment certainty and the verified cost movements to settle a fair, sustainable price for both of us?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Your letter (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days. As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +2.0%. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 129.11 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

We appreciate your revised offer and your acknowledgement of the notice period, and we value our partnership with your foundry. Comparing the proposed adjustment with the relevant driver indices would help establish a fair, sustainable basis without requiring disclosure of your internal calculation. In that partnership spirit, we would welcome a later effective date and could consider shorter payment terms in exchange for a lower unit price.

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Our demand forecast for Volute casing HN 50-200 is up +10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +2.0%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 129.11 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
